 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Tile the input four times, rotating each copy clockwise by its quadrant."""
    n = len(grid)
    if not n or any(len(row) != n for row in grid):
        raise ValueError("expected a non-empty square grid")
    rotations = [
        grid,
        [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])],
        [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]],
        [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1],
    ]
    top = [rotations[0][r] + rotations[1][r] for r in range(n)]
    bottom = [rotations[3][r] + rotations[2][r] for r in range(n)]
    return top + bottom
